sentences.text: This is an application under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure for anticipatory bail.

2. The applicant is apprehending his arrest in Crime No.51 of 2023 registered at Vadgaon Maval Police Station, Pune Rural for the ofences punishable under Sections 376, 452 and 323 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. I have heard the learned counsel appearing for the applicant and the learned APP for the respondent / State.
4. The allegations against the present applicant are of rape.
5. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the alleged act was consensual and the same is fortifed by the fact that no report was lodged immediately after the alleged incident.
It is submitted that the report came to be lodged after four days of 22-aba-518-23.doc alleged incident as the applicant and the prosecutrix were found together by the husband of the prosecutrix.

It is submitted that considering the overall facts and circumstances, the applicant may be released on anticipatory Bhanudas Bhagwant Modhale vs The State Of Maharashtra on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188077989/
1 bail.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have perused the statements of the prosecutrix.
Prima facie, I do not see any reason to doubt her version.
As regards delay in lodging the FIR, normally in such cases nobody immediately rushes to the police station to lodge the report.
Considering the nature of ofence, I am not inclined to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Hence, the Anticipatory Bail Application is rejected.

[N.R.BORKAR, J.]
